destination.prompt: Generate a single isolated destination waymarker prop sprite for a cozy hand painted anime fantasy RPG side scrolling road. True transparent alpha PNG background, centered full object with 10% margins. A weathered short wooden signpost standing on two small stones, one warm amber lantern hanging from a curved wooden bracket, a small carved wooden plaque with ONLY a simple pictogram of a little roof and warm light, a tied cream cloth ribbon. No letters, no words, no numbers, no text, no GOAL, no finish flag, no arrows. It should subtly suggest a welcoming arrival landmark at the end of a journey and be recognizable at 80-110px high. Slight three quarter side view, clean dark brown outlines, painterly warm wood and amber glass, simple clear silhouette. No scenery and no full ground shadow, no people. Sprite prop, not a UI button.

packing.prompt: NEW transparent game sprite atlas using the three provided sheets ONLY for character identity and anime painting style references. Exact 2 columns by 3 rows, six equal square cells with wide clear gutters, no text/grid/background. Row 1 Aria blonde elf in green flower hood, row 2 Leon brown-haired red cape blue tunic, row 3 Mira lavender-haired woman in white gold dress. All face RIGHT, fully within own cell, stationary KNEELING and carefully PACKING A SMALL CLOTH PARCEL: column 1 both hands low tying a string on a modest small package by their knees; column 2 sitting in same position checking a small plain paper tag held close to lap. Feet and body firmly in the same stationary position in both columns, no walking, no pushing extended arms. Hands busy in front close to body, not outstretched, no weapons in hands, no plants or flowers in hands. Bow/sword sheathed behind, staff absent. Consistent character proportions and colors from refs. Match cute 2-head-tall mobile RPG art, sharp outline and painted soft shading readable at 65px. TRUE alpha transparency, each sprite separated from other cells by at least 10 percent margin, no ground plane or glow.
